body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Ketika Profil Publik Developer Jadi Ladang Panen Penipuan". Tulisannya membahas ulasan praktis cara melindungi kontak publik pengembang dari panen data bot otomatis memakai alat alias dan proteksi web modern
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "When Developer Public Profiles Become a Goldmine for Scammers". It covers a practical evaluation of shielding developer public contact info from automated scrapers using modern alias tools and web defenses
